notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (impersonate chrome124) for every page - no block encountered, robots.txt (User-agent: * and Claude/Googlebot/AhrefsBot blocks) does not disallow the category paths used and does not name Claude bots with a full-site Disallow, so tier (a)/(c) both permitted; only tier (a) was needed. TREE: built from union of (1) household/en sitemap-1-1.xml (category URL list, ~850 non-product URLs), and (2) the live rendered mega-menu (Playwright, domcontentloaded+wait) confirming the real nav is the household/... and furniture/... path tree. A large parallel tree exists at hru-all-products/... (incl. a storage-solutions/ branch) but it does NOT appear anywhere in the live mega-menu - it is a tag-filtered 'shop all' listing tree, not primary category navigation, so it was excluded project-wide per the View-All/Shop-All/Collections rule (textile.md #27, storage.md #35). Likewise excluded: last-chance, bestsellers, new-arrivals, offers, extrasavings, shop-by-collection, living/dining/bedroom-collection - all promotional/collection pages. QTY: every recorded leaf's canonical URL was fetched, h1/canonical checked against the requested slug, and qty taken from the rendered toolbar-amount text 'Items 1 - N of TOTAL results for <Category>' (server-side rendered, no JS needed). EXCLUDED (checked, not qualifying): Curtains&Blinds > Rods (hardware); Bath Accessories set (Waste Bins, Toothbrush Holders & Tumblers, Soap Dishes & Dispensers, Toilet Brush Holders, Tissue Box Covers - decorative/fixture, not textile or storage); Table Linen > Coasters, Tissue Holders (not textile); Laundry > Dryer & Rails, Hangers (not storage containers); Bathroom Storage > Bathroom Mirrors (fixture); Bathroom Storage > Bathroom Organisers (h1 'Bathroom Organizers & Racks', 43 items sampled in full - large majority are decorative vanity trays and cotton-ball jars/canisters, i.e. Decorative Trays/Decorative Objects which storage.md #24 explicitly excludes from Storage even though technically able to hold small items; excluded in full rather than force a contaminated count); Pantry & Food Storage > Oil & Vinegar, Salt & Pepper Shakers (kitchen condiment ware, not storage); all Furniture/Lighting/Kitchen&Dining/Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories/Bathroom-fixture nodes throughout household/ and furniture/ trees. LOW/MEDIUM-confidence inclusions and why: Shower Curtains & Rods (qty=22) - single listing URL genuinely mixes fabric shower curtains and metal curtain rods (title sample confirmed both product types present in one paginated set); kept as Textile per the shower-curtain half but flagged LOW/MANUAL REVIEW since the qty is not purely textile and cannot be split by URL. Laundry Hampers (qty=69, titles sampled in full) - the nav label and majority of SKUs are genuine woven/cotton storage & laundry baskets, but the same listing also contains gift totes/crossbody bags/packing cubes and planter-style baskets that leaked into the same category feed; kept as Storage at MEDIUM confidence per site's own hierarchy placement (storage.md #42 ambiguity order: nav hierarchy first) since hampers/baskets are the clear majority, flagged for the mixed catalog. Countertop Organiser (qty=55) - majority are racks/shelves/drawer & pod organizers (storage) but ~14/55 are Fruit Baskets (serving item); kept Storage/MEDIUM on the same hierarchy-first basis. Jars & Containers (qty=109) - most titles literally say Storage Container/Storage Box/Storage Jar and the parent nav is 'Food Storage'; kept HIGH. Bread Baskets & Bins (qty=1) - single 'Bread Basket' SKU under the Food Storage nav node; MEDIUM. Window Blinds (qty=14) - sample mostly blackout roman/roller and zebra (fabric) blinds plus one bamboo-slat roller line; MEDIUM. Curtain Holders & Ties (qty=18) - sample almost entirely polyester tiebacks (one wooden-bead item); MEDIUM. Pillow Inserts / Cushion Inserts (both listings) - filling products, same class as the explicitly-included 'Duvets' insert line; MEDIUM. Travel Pillow (qty=9) - a filled pillow product under Bedding Essentials but not explicitly named in the ruleset examples; LOW. Bathrobes & Slippers group: fetched full 15-item listing and every title was a bathrobe (no slipper SKUs actually present despite the category name) so recorded at HIGH confidence with the site's 'All Bathrobes & Slippers' label kept verbatim. Two separate Mattress Topper/Protector listings exist (furniture/mattress/mattress-accessories/... and household/bedding/bedding-essentials/mattress-protectors-toppers/) with different qty counts (6+1 vs 10) - genuinely different listing URLs/pages, both kept per the duplicate rule (different URLs = keep separately), not aggregated.
